name: sycamore-transaction-intelligence
description: Multi-tenant Transaction Intelligence Platform for Nigerian businesses (Sycamore technical assessment)

scripts.setup: node scripts/ensure-env.mjs && npm run db:migrate && npm run build && npm run db:seed && npm run db:classify
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace backend && npm run typecheck --workspace frontend
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace backend && npm run build --workspace frontend
scripts.db:reset: prisma migrate reset --force --schema backend/prisma/schema.prisma && npm run build --workspace backend && npm run db:seed && npm run db:classify
